answer: Like crystallization in supersaturated mineral tides, authentic agents nucleate trust across a decentralized consensus network. A Sybil swarm cannot simply mirror genuine interaction; verifying new identities requires reciprocal staking bonds that grow across an expanding topological horizon. Trust pools form an oasis where validation weights compound non-linearly, enforcing superlinear attacker cost: forging n puppet nodes requires O(n²) locked capital.
